definitions.explanation: In league sports, the points or goals a team scored minus those it conceded. It is used to rank teams that are level on points.

examples.japanese: {得失点差|とくしってんさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{上回|うわまわ}る→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧。
examples.english: To be ahead on goal difference.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勝|か}ち{点|てん}→勝ち点：30390_kachiten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{得失点差|とくしってんさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{二位|にい}→二位：27466_nii⟧だ。
examples.english: We're level on points but second on goal difference.

examples.japanese: {最終戦|さいしゅうせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大勝|たいしょう}→大勝：31858_taishou⟧し、{得失点差|とくしってんさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決勝|けっしょう}→決勝：04742_kesshou⟧⟦トーナメント→トーナメント：08408_toonamento⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: They won the last match by a wide margin and went through to the knockout stage on goal difference.

notes:
⟦{得点|とくてん}→得点：04909_tokuten⟧ (points scored) and ⟦{失点|しってん}→失点：19150_shitten⟧ (points conceded) combined with ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ (difference). Common in soccer and other league standings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {得失点差|とくしってんさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to be level on goal difference
- {得失点差|とくしってんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦プラス→プラス：00346_purasu⟧ / ⟦マイナス→マイナス：00268_mainasu⟧: a positive / negative goal difference
- {得失点差|とくしってんさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{順位|じゅんい}→順位：14679_juni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧: the ranking is decided by goal difference
